injuries.detail: Goodwin (calf) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Spurs, Kellan Olson of ArizonaSports.com reports.
Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Vassell (groin) is out for Monday's game against the Suns, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
Harris (calf) is listed as out for Monday's game against Phoenix.
Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
